episode.title: Beware of Industrial Policy

chapters.title: Chapter 9: What Should the State Do?

episode.tagline: There are few things a government can do to harm society more than Industrial policy. It sounds well-intentioned, but is born out of hubris and results in disaster.
episode.about: In this episode, Ajay breaks down the thinking behind industrial policy, the practice of it, and why it is always bad for the people.
